sentences.text:
1. Burasi Surja Paharia, aged about 45 years, son of Late Dolo Mesa
 Pahariya, resident of Village- Bada Bararo, P.O. & P.S.- Rajabhitha,
 District- Godda.

2. Janjlu @ Janjalu Murmu, aged about 43 years, son of Late Saiba
 Murmu, resident of Village- Samukhiya More, P.O. & P.S.-
 Rajabhitha, District- Godda.
 .... Petitioners
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand .... Opp. Party
 ------
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

------
For the Petitioners : Ms. Amrita Sinha, Advocate Mr. Saurabh Raj, Advocate For the Opp. Party :
Mr. Rajesh Kumar, A.P.P.
-----
2/ 08.09.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioners have been made accused in connection with S.T. No. 145 of 2024 arising out of Rajabhitha P.S. Case No. 4 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. No. 933 of 2023 for the offences registered under Sections 376-D, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Godda.
3. On 09.03.2024 at about 10.00 am, the petitioners are alleged to have committed gang rape upon the prosecutrix.
4. Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
Accordingly, their prayer for bail is rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) R.Kr.
